literature.headline_zh: 发热伴血小板减少综合征病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期发热伴血小板减少综合征病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 该审查确定了一个广泛的动物 宿主 范围,包括至少 15 种脊椎动物,涵盖家养、野生动物和伴侣类别。国内反刍动物表现出高 血清流行率 并充当初级放大 宿主。野生动物(例如啮齿动物、鼩鼱)有助于地方动物的维持。猫高度易感,会患上高病毒载量的严重疾病,并且是人类直接非 媒介 传播 的主要来源。狗通常患有轻微疾病,但可以持续传播病毒。传播 主要通过长角血蜱传播,但通过接触患病动物(特别是猫和养殖水貂)的血液/分泌物直接传播 传播 也很重要。 [10.1186/s40249-026-01505-x]
在1,660例报告病例中,1,508例(90.8%)发生在50岁以上人群中,1,042例(62.8%)发生在农民中。年度病例数从2015年的30例增加到2024年的428例和2025年的345例。总体来看,97.6%的病例发生在4月至10月,高负担地区和高高空间集群集中在苏西南地区。 [10.3389/fpubh.2026.1994199]
所有三例人类病例均经实验室确诊为 SFTSV,他们回顾性地报告了在症状出现之前对患病金毛猎犬的密切护理。随后的测试证实了这只狗感染了 SFTSV,并从其中采集了一只蜱虫。 [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014215]
我们的研究结果表明,甘油磷脂代谢是SFTSV感染的Huh7细胞和发热伴血小板减少综合征患者中最显着破坏的途径,溶血磷脂酰胆碱(LPC)种类,包括LPC(16:1)、LPC(18:1)、LPC(16:0)和LPC(18:0),表现出水平下降。 [10.1128/msphere.00557-26]

475 名患者中,378 名(79.6%)存活,97 名(20.4%)死亡。入院时非幸存者的 BUN/FIB 水平显着高于幸存者。BUN/FIB 显示的表观 AUC 为 0.835(95% CI:0.791-0.880),队列研究 衍生的截止值为 3.312 mmol/g。该阈值的敏感性为 78.4%,特异性为 78.0%,但需要外部验证。BUN/FIB 显示出比传统炎症指数更高的明显区分度,并且与 Ct 衍生的 SFTSV RNA 负荷具有相当的明显区分度。较高的 BUN/FIB 与较差的生存率相关。在配对分析中,幸存者的 BUN/FIB 下降,非幸存者的 BUN/FIB 上升。 [10.2147/idr.s634788]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.headline_en: Recent Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus literature
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The review identified a broad animal host range comprising at least 15 vertebrate species across domestic, wildlife, and companion categories. Domestic ruminants show high seroprevalence and act as primary amplification hosts. Wildlife (e.g., rodents, shrews) contribute to enzootic maintenance. [10.1186/s40249-026-01505-x]

Among 1,660 reported cases, 1,508 (90.8%) occurred in persons aged ≥50 years and 1,042 (62.8%) among farmers. Annual cases increased from 30 in 2015 to 428 in 2024 and 345 in 2025. [10.3389/fpubh.2026.1994199]

All three human cases were laboratory-confirmed for SFTSV, and they retrospectively reported close care to a sick golden retriever prior to symptom onset. Subsequent testing confirmed SFTSV infection in the dog and a tick collected from it. [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014215]

Our findings revealed that glycerophospholipid metabolism was the most significantly disrupted pathway in both SFTSV-infected Huh7 cells and SFTS patients, with lysophosphatidylcholine (LPC) species, including LPC(16:1), LPC(18:1), LPC(16:0), and LPC(18:0), showing decreased levels. [10.1128/msphere.00557-26]

Of the 475 patients, 378 (79.6%) survived and 97 (20.4%) died. Admission BUN/FIB levels were significantly higher in non-survivors than in survivors. BUN/FIB showed an apparent AUC of 0.835 (95% CI: 0.791-0.880), with a cohort-derived cut-off of 3.312 mmol/g. [10.2147/idr.s634788]

papers.title: The role of animals in the epidemiology and pathogenesis of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS): a scoping review
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is an emerging tick-borne zoonosis with a high case-fatality rate and expanding geographic range. Its persistence depends on complex cycles involving ticks and vertebrate animal hosts. A comprehensive understanding of animal roles is critical for predicting spillover risk and developing effective interventions under a One Health framework. This scoping review aimed to map and synthesize existing evidence on the roles of domestic animals, wildlife, and companion animals in the epidemiology, pathogenesis, and transmission of SFTSV. Methods A scoping review was conducted following PRISMA-ScR guidelines. Multiple databases (MEDLINE, PubMed, Web of Science, China National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang) and grey literature sources were searched from January 1, 2011 to October 21, 2025. Eligible studies involved non-human animals or ticks and confirmed SFTSV infection or exposure. Evidence was narratively synthesized across prespecified themes: animal host roles, clinical manifestations, transmission dynamics, and prevention strategies. We mapped the distribution of evidence across animal species, study designs, geographic regions, diagnostic approaches, and thematic domains. Results The review identified a broad animal host range comprising at least 15 vertebrate species across domestic, wildlife, and companion categories. Domestic ruminants show high seroprevalence and act as primary amplification hosts. Wildlife (e.g., rodents, shrews) contribute to enzootic maintenance. Cats are highly susceptible, develop severe disease with high viral loads, and are a major source of direct non-vector transmission to humans. Dogs often have mild illness but can shed virus persistently. Transmission primarily occurs via the tick Haemaphysalis longicornis , but direct transmission via contact with blood/secretions of sick animals (especially cats and farmed mink) is significant. Prevention requires integrated tick management, biosecurity in veterinary/farm settings, and public education. Conclusions Animals are central to the ecology of SFTSV. Current evidence underscores the necessity of integrated, multisectoral One Health strategies for surveillance, risk communication, and control. Future research priorities include standardizing host-competence studies, harmonizing diagnostics, elucidating comparative immunopathology, and evaluating the feasibility and impact of intervention bundles, including potential veterinary vaccines.

A comprehensive understanding of animal roles is critical for predicting spillover risk and developing effective interventions under a One Health framework. This scoping review aimed to map and synthesize existing evidence on the roles of domestic animals, wildlife, and companion animals in the epidemiology, pathogenesis, and transmission of SFTSV. Methods A scoping review was conducted following PRISMA-ScR guidelines. Multiple databases (MEDLINE, PubMed, Web of Science, China National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang) and grey literature sources were searched from January 1, 2011 to October 21, 2025. Eligible studies involved non-human animals or ticks and confirmed SFTSV infection or exposure. Evidence was narratively synthesized across prespecified themes: animal host roles, clinical manifestations, transmission dynamics, and prevention strategies. We mapped the distribution of evidence across animal species, study designs, geographic regions, diagnostic approaches, and thematic domains. Results The review identified a broad animal host range comprising at least 15 vertebrate species across domestic, wildlife, and companion categories. Domestic ruminants show high seroprevalence and act as primary amplification hosts. Wildlife (e.g., rodents, shrews) contribute to enzootic maintenance. Cats are highly susceptible, develop severe disease with high viral loads, and are a major source of direct non-vector transmission to humans. Dogs often have mild illness but can shed virus persistently. Transmission primarily occurs via the tick Haemaphysalis longicornis , but direct transmission via contact with blood/secretions of sick animals (especially cats and farmed mink) is significant. Prevention requires integrated tick management, biosecurity in veterinary/farm settings, and public education. Conclusions Animals are central to the ecology of SFTSV. Current evidence underscores the necessity of integrated, multisectoral One Health strategies for surveillance, risk communication, and control. Future research priorities include standardizing host-competence studies, harmonizing diagnostics, elucidating comparative immunopathology, and evaluating the feasibility and impact of intervention bundles, including potential veterinary vaccines.

analysis.summary_en: This scoping review explores the role of animals in the epidemiology and pathogenesis of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) caused by SFTSV. The study highlights the broad range of animal hosts, including domestic ruminants, wildlife, and companion animals, and emphasizes the importance of understanding these roles for predicting spillover risk and implementing effective interventions. The review identifies key findings such as the high seroprevalence in domestic ruminants, the role of wildlife in enzootic maintenance, and the significant direct transmission from cats and farmed mink to humans. It also underscores the need for integrated tick management, biosecurity measures, and public education. Future research should focus on standardizing host-competence studies, harmonizing diagnostics, and evaluating intervention strategies, including potential veterinary vaccines.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 严重发热伴血小板减少综合征(发热伴血小板减少综合征)是一种新兴疾病,病死率高,地理范围不断扩大。它的持久性取决于涉及蜱和脊椎动物 宿主 的复杂循环。全面了解动物角色对于预测 跨物种溢出 风险和在 One Health 框架下制定有效干预措施至关重要。本次范围界定审查旨在绘制和综合有关家畜、野生动物和伴侣动物在 SFTSV 的 流行病学、发病机制 和 传播 中的作用的现有证据。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 根据 PRISMA-ScR 指南进行了范围界定审查。检索了2011年1月1日至2025年10月21日期间的多个数据库(MEDLINE、PubMed、Web of Science、中国国家知识基础设施、万方)和灰色文献来源。符合条件的研究涉及非人类动物或蜱,并证实SFTSV感染或暴露。证据以预先指定的主题进行叙述性综合:动物 宿主 角色、临床表现、传播 动态和预防策略。我们绘制了证据在动物物种、研究设计、地理区域、诊断方法和主题领域的分布情况。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该审查确定了一个广泛的动物 宿主 范围,包括至少 15 种脊椎动物,涵盖家养、野生动物和伴侣类别。国内反刍动物表现出高 血清流行率 并充当初级放大 宿主。野生动物(例如啮齿动物、鼩鼱)有助于地方动物的维持。猫高度易感,会患上高病毒载量的严重疾病,并且是人类直接非 媒介 传播 的主要来源。狗通常患有轻微疾病,但可以持续传播病毒。传播 主要通过长角血蜱传播,但通过接触患病动物(特别是猫和养殖水貂)的血液/分泌物直接传播 传播 也很重要。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 所提供的证据并未报告与 SFTSV 流行病学 和 发病机制 中动物的作用相关的具体争议或证据差距。然而,该综述强调需要进一步研究来标准化 宿主 能力研究、协调诊断并阐明比较免疫病理学。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 预防需要综合蜱虫管理、兽医/农场环境中的生物安全以及公共教育。目前的证据强调了针对 监测、风险沟通和控制采取综合的、多部门的“同一个健康”战略的必要性。未来的研究重点包括标准化 宿主 能力研究、协调诊断、阐明比较免疫病理学以及评估干预措施的可行性和影响,包括潜在的兽医 疫苗。

papers.title: Persistent viral carriage of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus in canine: A potential canine-to-human transmission event in a family cluster
papers.abstract: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is a tick-borne viral disease with a substantial case-fatality rate. Here, we reported a family cluster of SFTS cases in Southeast China. The index case was a 57-year-old man, whose son and wife subsequently developed SFTS-compatible symptoms at two and three days after his onset, respectively. All three cases were laboratory-confirmed for SFTS, and retrospectively reported close care to a sick golden retriever prior to symptom onset. In contrast, the other two family members without such canine exposure remained serologically and clinically uninfected. All three cases denied a tick-biting history before illness onset. Subsequent testing confirmed SFTS virus (SFTSV) infection in the golden retriever, and SFTSV was also detected in a tick collected from the dog. Longitudinal viral screening of serial canine samples revealed persistent SFTSV shedding: viral positivity was sustained for 23 days in nasal swabs and urethral swabs, 27 days in serum samples, and at least 30 days in rectal swabs following its symptom onset. Genomic analysis showed near-identical SFTSV sequences from the index case and the infected dog, with identities of 99.94% for the small segment, 100% for the medium segment, and 99.98% for the large segment. This study reveals prolonged SFTSV shedding in infected canine, suggests a plausible risk of canine-to-human SFTSV transmission, and highlights the potential role of dogs in the spread and evolution of SFTSV.

papers.title: LPC(16:0) and prothrombin time as mortality predictors in severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is an emerging tick-borne viral disease with a high fatality rate. However, the impact of the SFTS virus (SFTSV) on host lipid metabolism and its relationship with the prognosis of patients remain unclear. To determine the lipid metabolism profile of SFTSV-infected and identify prognostic biomarkers, targeted lipidomics analysis was conducted on SFTSV-infected Huh7 cells and serum samples from 71 subjects (including 15 healthy controls, 35 SFTS survivors, and 21 SFTS deceased patients) in this study. Our findings revealed that glycerophospholipid metabolism was the most significantly disrupted pathway in both SFTSV-infected Huh7 cells and SFTS patients, with lysophosphatidylcholine (LPC) species, including LPC(16:1), LPC(18:1), LPC(16:0), and LPC(18:0), showing decreased levels. Together with clinical parameters, prothrombin time (PT) and LPC(16:0) were further identified as prognostic factors, and the combined model incorporating these two markers predicted mortality with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.937. These findings provide a foundation for mortality prediction and mechanistic understanding of SFTS. IMPORTANCE Effective prognostic tools and targeted therapies for SFTS remain urgently needed, as current clinical management relies largely on supportive care and lacks reliable indicators for early risk stratification. This study enhances our understanding of lipid alterations following SFTSV infection, opens potential avenues for metabolism-targeted intervention, and may aid in assessing disease progression and guiding appropriate clinical interventions.

However, the impact of the SFTS virus (SFTSV) on host lipid metabolism and its relationship with the prognosis of patients remain unclear. To determine the lipid metabolism profile of SFTSV-infected and identify prognostic biomarkers, targeted lipidomics analysis was conducted on SFTSV-infected Huh7 cells and serum samples from 71 subjects (including 15 healthy controls, 35 SFTS survivors, and 21 SFTS deceased patients) in this study. Our findings revealed that glycerophospholipid metabolism was the most significantly disrupted pathway in both SFTSV-infected Huh7 cells and SFTS patients, with lysophosphatidylcholine (LPC) species, including LPC(16:1), LPC(18:1), LPC(16:0), and LPC(18:0), showing decreased levels. Together with clinical parameters, prothrombin time (PT) and LPC(16:0) were further identified as prognostic factors, and the combined model incorporating these two markers predicted mortality with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.937. These findings provide a foundation for mortality prediction and mechanistic understanding of SFTS.IMPORTANCEEffective prognostic tools and targeted therapies for SFTS remain urgently needed, as current clinical management relies largely on supportive care and lacks reliable indicators for early risk stratification. This study enhances our understanding of lipid alterations following SFTSV infection, opens potential avenues for metabolism-targeted intervention, and may aid in assessing disease progression and guiding appropriate clinical interventions.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 为了确定SFTSV感染者的脂质代谢谱并确定预后生物标志物,本研究对SFTSV感染的Huh7细胞和71名受试者(包括15名健康对照、35名发热伴血小板减少综合征幸存者和21名发热伴血小板减少综合征死亡患者)的血清样本进行了靶向脂质组学分析。
elements_zh.methods: 对来自 71 名受试者(包括 15 名健康对照、35 名 发热伴血小板减少综合征 幸存者和 21 名 发热伴血小板减少综合征 死亡患者)的 SFTSV 感染 Huh7 细胞和血清样本进行了靶向脂质组学分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 我们的研究结果表明,甘油磷脂代谢是SFTSV感染的Huh7细胞和发热伴血小板减少综合征患者中最显着破坏的途径,溶血磷脂酰胆碱(LPC)种类,包括LPC(16:1)、LPC(18:1)、LPC(16:0)和LPC(18:0),表现出水平下降。

papers.title: Prognostic Value of the Blood Urea Nitrogen-to-Fibrinogen Ratio for 30-Day Mortality in Patients with Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome: A Single-Center Retrospective Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is an emerging tick-borne viral disease associated with substantial mortality. Renal dysfunction and coagulation abnormalities are closely related to disease severity. This study aimed to evaluate the prognostic significance of the blood urea nitrogen-to-fibrinogen ratio (BUN/FIB) in patients with SFTS. METHODS: This single-center retrospective cohort study included adult patients with laboratory-confirmed SFTS admitted to the First Affiliated Hospital of the University of Science and Technology of China between June 2020 and June 2025. Admission BUN/FIB was calculated using BUN and fibrinogen values. Logistic regression, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, survival analysis, and paired-sample analysis were performed to evaluate the association between BUN/FIB and 30-day all-cause mortality. RESULTS: Of the 475 patients, 378 (79.6%) survived and 97 (20.4%) died. Admission BUN/FIB levels were significantly higher in non-survivors than in survivors. Multivariable logistic regression identified older age, neurological signs, higher C-reactive protein, higher Ct-derived SFTSV RNA burden, and higher BUN/FIB (OR: 1.565; 95% CI: 1.348-1.851; P<0.001) as independently associated with 30-day mortality. BUN/FIB showed an apparent AUC of 0.835 (95% CI: 0.791-0.880), with a cohort-derived cut-off of 3.312 mmol/g. This threshold showed a sensitivity of 78.4% and specificity of 78.0% but requires external validation. BUN/FIB showed higher apparent discrimination than conventional inflammatory indices and comparable apparent discrimination with Ct-derived SFTSV RNA burden. Higher BUN/FIB was associated with poorer survival. In paired analyses, BUN/FIB decreased among survivors and increased among non-survivors. CONCLUSION: Admission BUN/FIB was independently associated with 30-day mortality and showed favorable apparent discriminatory performance in this retrospective cohort. BUN/FIB may serve as a candidate adjunctive prognostic marker, but its optimal threshold, clinical utility, and generalizability require validation in prospective multicenter studies.

The research aimed to evaluate whether BUN/FIB could serve as a useful marker for predicting disease severity and outcomes. The study included 475 adult patients with laboratory-confirmed SFTS admitted to a single hospital between 2020 and 2025. BUN/FIB was calculated using blood urea nitrogen and fibrinogen levels, and statistical methods such as logistic regression, ROC analysis, and survival analysis were employed. The findings suggest that BUN/FIB could be a potential prognostic marker for SFTS, though its clinical utility and generalizability require confirmation in larger, prospective studies. The study's limitations include its retrospective design and single-center setting, which may affect the strength of the evidence.

papers.title_zh: 30 天 死亡率 的血液尿素氮与纤维蛋白原比率对严重发热伴血小板减少综合征患者的预后价值:单中心回顾性 队列研究 研究。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is an emerging tick-borne viral disease associated with substantial mortality. Renal dysfunction and coagulation abnormalities are closely related to disease severity. This study aimed to evaluate the prognostic significance of the blood urea nitrogen-to-fibrinogen ratio (BUN/FIB) in patients with SFTS. METHODS: This single-center retrospective cohort study included adult patients with laboratory-confirmed SFTS admitted to the First Affiliated Hospital of the University of Science and Technology of China between June 2020 and June 2025. Admission BUN/FIB was calculated using BUN and fibrinogen values. Logistic regression, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, survival analysis, and paired-sample analysis were performed to evaluate the association between BUN/FIB and 30-day all-cause mortality. RESULTS: Of the 475 patients, 378 (79.6%) survived and 97 (20.4%) died. Admission BUN/FIB levels were significantly higher in non-survivors than in survivors. Multivariable logistic regression identified older age, neurological signs, higher C-reactive protein, higher Ct-derived SFTSV RNA burden, and higher BUN/FIB (OR: 1.565; 95% CI: 1.348-1.851; P<0.001) as independently associated with 30-day mortality. BUN/FIB showed an apparent AUC of 0.835 (95% CI: 0.791-0.880), with a cohort-derived cut-off of 3.312 mmol/g. This threshold showed a sensitivity of 78.4% and specificity of 78.0% but requires external validation. BUN/FIB showed higher apparent discrimination than conventional inflammatory indices and comparable apparent discrimination with Ct-derived SFTSV RNA burden. Higher BUN/FIB was associated with poorer survival. In paired analyses, BUN/FIB decreased among survivors and increased among non-survivors. CONCLUSION: Admission BUN/FIB was independently associated with 30-day mortality and showed favorable apparent discriminatory performance in this retrospective cohort. BUN/FIB may serve as a candidate adjunctive prognostic marker, but its optimal threshold, clinical utility, and generalizability require validation in prospective multicenter studies.

papers.title: Coinfection patterns and associations of tick-borne pathogens in natural foci of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome: A One Health approach
papers.abstract: Background Tick-borne pathogens (TBPs) circulate in complex ecological systems involving vectors, animal hosts, and humans. Coinfections have been shown to influence clinical outcomes and may complicate pathogen associations, yet current research remains limited. Methods We adopted a One Health approach in Taizhou City, a severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) endemic area, by collecting 485 community residents, 90 confirmed SFTS patients, 1081 ticks, and 471 small mammals. Five TBPs, including Anaplasma spp., Bartonella spp., Coxiella spp., Ehrlichia spp., and spotted fever group rickettsiae (SFGR), were detected using indirect immunofluorescence assay or polymerase chain reaction. We subsequently analyzed pathogen prevalence and coinfection patterns, assessed pathogen-pathogen associations, and evaluated cross-host correlations at the township level. Results All five TBPs were detected across ticks, small mammals, and humans, with prevalence varying substantially. Human IgG showed diverse co-seropositivity, while coinfections in ticks and small mammals were limited. Significant pathogen-pathogen associations were observed: Anaplasma spp./ Ehrlichia spp. and Ehrlichia spp./SFGR in humans, and Anaplasma spp./ Coxiella spp. in small mammals. Cross-host correlations included positive associations of SFGR in ticks with community residents, Bartonella spp. in small mammals with community residents, and significant links of Anaplasma spp./ Ehrlichia spp. and Anaplasma spp./SFGR between ticks and community residents. Conclusions Multiple TBPs co-circulate in this SFTS epidemic area, following distinct exposure routes involving ticks and small mammals. Anaplasma spp., Ehrlichia spp., and SFGR are tick-borne, while Bartonella spp. is more associated with small mammals. IgG co-seropositivity in humans likely reflects repeated or long-term exposures rather than a single tick bite. These findings suggest that effective prevention should consider human activity patterns and the role of small mammals in sustaining pathogen circulation, while a One Health approach integrating humans, animals, and vectors can guide the development of more targeted control strategies.

papers.title_zh: 严重发热伴血小板减少综合征自然病灶中 蜱媒 病原体的混合感染模式和关联:一种单一健康方法
papers.source_body_en: Background Tick-borne pathogens (TBPs) circulate in complex ecological systems involving vectors, animal hosts, and humans. Coinfections have been shown to influence clinical outcomes and may complicate pathogen associations, yet current research remains limited. Methods We adopted a One Health approach in Taizhou City, a severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) endemic area, by collecting 485 community residents, 90 confirmed SFTS patients, 1081 ticks, and 471 small mammals. Five TBPs, including Anaplasma spp., Bartonella spp., Coxiella spp., Ehrlichia spp., and spotted fever group rickettsiae (SFGR), were detected using indirect immunofluorescence assay or polymerase chain reaction. We subsequently analyzed pathogen prevalence and coinfection patterns, assessed pathogen-pathogen associations, and evaluated cross-host correlations at the township level. Results All five TBPs were detected across ticks, small mammals, and humans, with prevalence varying substantially. Human IgG showed diverse co-seropositivity, while coinfections in ticks and small mammals were limited. Significant pathogen-pathogen associations were observed: Anaplasma spp./ Ehrlichia spp. and Ehrlichia spp./SFGR in humans, and Anaplasma spp./ Coxiella spp. in small mammals. Cross-host correlations included positive associations of SFGR in ticks with community residents, Bartonella spp. in small mammals with community residents, and significant links of Anaplasma spp./ Ehrlichia spp. and Anaplasma spp./SFGR between ticks and community residents. Conclusions Multiple TBPs co-circulate in this SFTS epidemic area, following distinct exposure routes involving ticks and small mammals. Anaplasma spp., Ehrlichia spp., and SFGR are tick-borne, while Bartonella spp. is more associated with small mammals. IgG co-seropositivity in humans likely reflects repeated or long-term exposures rather than a single tick bite. These findings suggest that effective prevention should consider human activity patterns and the role of small mammals in sustaining pathogen circulation, while a One Health approach integrating humans, animals, and vectors can guide the development of more targeted control strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 蜱媒 病原体 (TBP) 在涉及 媒介、动物 宿主 和人类的复杂生态系统中循环。合并感染已被证明会影响临床结果,并可能使病原体关联复杂化,但目前的研究仍然有限。方法在发热伴血小板减少综合征(发热伴血小板减少综合征)流行区泰州市采取“同一个健康”方法,收集了485名社区居民、90例确诊的发热伴血小板减少综合征患者、1081只蜱虫和471只小型哺乳动物。使用间接免疫荧光法或聚合酶链反应检测了五种 TBP,包括无形体属、巴尔通体属、柯克斯体属、埃利希体属和斑疹热群立克次体 (SFGR)。随后,我们分析了病原体 患病率 和合并感染模式,评估了病原体与病原体之间的关联,并评估了乡镇一级的交叉 宿主 相关性。结果 所有五种 TBP 在蜱、小型哺乳动物和人类中均被检测到,其中 患病率 差异很大。人类 IgG 显示出多种共血清阳性,而蜱和小型哺乳动物的共感染情况有限。观察到显着的病原体-病原体关联:无形体属/埃利希体属。和人类埃利希体属/SFGR,以及无形体属/柯克斯体属。在小型哺乳动物中。交叉 宿主 相关性包括蜱中 SFGR 与社区居民巴尔通体属的正相关。在具有社区居民的小型哺乳动物中,无形体属/埃利希体属有重要联系。以及蜱虫和社区居民之间的无形体属/SFGR。结论 多种 TBP 在 发热伴血小板减少综合征 流行区共同循环,遵循涉及蜱和小型哺乳动物的不同暴露途径。无形体属、埃利希体属和 SFGR 为 蜱媒,而巴尔通体属为 蜱媒。与小型哺乳动物更相关。人类 IgG 联合血清阳性可能反映的是反复或长期接触,而不是单次蜱虫叮咬。这些发现表明,有效的预防应考虑人类活动模式和小型哺乳动物在维持病原体循环中的作用,而整合人类、动物和 媒介 的“同一个健康”方法可以指导制定更有针对性的控制策略。

papers.title: Epidemiological patterns and surveillance-based forecasting of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome in Jiangsu Province, China, 2015–2025
papers.abstract: Background Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is an emerging tick-borne infectious disease with marked seasonality and geographic heterogeneity. Long-term public health surveillance and independently validated forecasting may help translate routine case reporting into targeted prevention and preparedness. Methods We analysed clinically diagnosed and laboratory-confirmed SFTS cases reported in Jiangsu Province, China, from January 2015 to December 2025. Demographic, occupational, temporal, and county/district-level spatial patterns were described, and local spatial autocorrelation was assessed. Monthly case counts from 2015 to 2023 were used for model development, while 2024–2025 data were reserved for independent temporal testing. Seasonal autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA), random forest (RF), long short-term memory (LSTM), and weighted ensemble (WE) models were compared using root mean squared error (RMSE), mean squared error (MSE), and mean absolute error (MAE). Results Among 1,660 reported cases, 1,508 (90.8%) occurred in persons aged ≥50 years and 1,042 (62.8%) among farmers. Annual cases increased from 30 in 2015 to 428 in 2024 and 345 in 2025. Overall, 97.6% of cases occurred from April to October, and high-burden areas and high-high spatial clusters were concentrated in southwestern Jiangsu. In the independent testing period, ARIMA achieved the lowest errors (RMSE 15.31, MSE 234.23, MAE 9.70), followed closely by WE (RMSE 16.25, MSE 264.13, MAE 10.50), whereas RF and LSTM showed larger errors. Refit to the complete series, ARIMA projected recurrent warm-season increases in 2026–2027, with uncertainty widening over the forecast horizon. Conclusion SFTS in Jiangsu showed a clear person–place–time pattern that can inform targeted public health action. The best overall out-of-sample performance of a parsimonious ARIMA model demonstrates that routine surveillance data can support practical seasonal forecasting when richer environmental or entomological data streams are unavailable. Forecasts should be updated regularly and used alongside routine epidemiological assessment.

papers.title_zh: 2015-2025年中国江苏省发热伴血小板减少综合征流行病学特征及基于监测的预测
papers.source_body_en: Background Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is an emerging tick-borne infectious disease with marked seasonality and geographic heterogeneity. Long-term public health surveillance and independently validated forecasting may help translate routine case reporting into targeted prevention and preparedness. Methods We analysed clinically diagnosed and laboratory-confirmed SFTS cases reported in Jiangsu Province, China, from January 2015 to December 2025. Demographic, occupational, temporal, and county/district-level spatial patterns were described, and local spatial autocorrelation was assessed. Monthly case counts from 2015 to 2023 were used for model development, while 2024–2025 data were reserved for independent temporal testing. Seasonal autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA), random forest (RF), long short-term memory (LSTM), and weighted ensemble (WE) models were compared using root mean squared error (RMSE), mean squared error (MSE), and mean absolute error (MAE). Results Among 1,660 reported cases, 1,508 (90.8%) occurred in persons aged ≥50 years and 1,042 (62.8%) among farmers. Annual cases increased from 30 in 2015 to 428 in 2024 and 345 in 2025. Overall, 97.6% of cases occurred from April to October, and high-burden areas and high-high spatial clusters were concentrated in southwestern Jiangsu. In the independent testing period, ARIMA achieved the lowest errors (RMSE 15.31, MSE 234.23, MAE 9.70), followed closely by WE (RMSE 16.25, MSE 264.13, MAE 10.50), whereas RF and LSTM showed larger errors. Refit to the complete series, ARIMA projected recurrent warm-season increases in 2026–2027, with uncertainty widening over the forecast horizon. Conclusion SFTS in Jiangsu showed a clear person–place–time pattern that can inform targeted public health action. The best overall out-of-sample performance of a parsimonious ARIMA model demonstrates that routine surveillance data can support practical seasonal forecasting when richer environmental or entomological data streams are unavailable. Forecasts should be updated regularly and used alongside routine epidemiological assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景严重发热伴血小板减少综合征(发热伴血小板减少综合征)是一种新出现的蜱媒传染病,具有明显的季节性和地域异质性。长期公共卫生 监测 和独立验证的预测可能有助于将常规病例报告转化为有针对性的预防和准备。方法 我们分析了中国江苏省 2015 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月报告的临床诊断和实验室确诊的 发热伴血小板减少综合征 病例。描述了人口、职业、时间和县/区级的空间模式,并评估了局部空间自相关。2015 年至 2023 年的每月病例数用于模型开发,而 2024 年至 2025 年的数据则保留用于独立时间测试。使用均方根误差 (RMSE)、均方误差 (MSE) 和平均绝对误差 (MAE) 比较季节性自回归积分移动平均 (ARIMA)、随机森林 (RF)、长短期记忆 (LSTM) 和加权集成 (WE) 模型。结果 1 660例报告病例中,50岁以上人群1 508例(90.8%),农民1 042例(62.8%)。年度病例数从2015年的30例增加到2024年的428例和2025年的345例。总体来看,97.6%的病例发生在4月至10月,高负担地区和高高空间集群集中在苏西南地区。在独立测试期间,ARIMA 的误差最低(RMSE 15.31、MSE 234.23、MAE 9.70),紧随其后的是 WE(RMSE 16.25、MSE 264.13、MAE 10.50),而 RF 和 LSTM 的误差较大。对整个系列进行修改后,ARIMA 预测 2026 年至 2027 年暖季会出现周期性增长,预测范围内的不确定性将扩大。结论 江苏的 发热伴血小板减少综合征 显示出清晰的人-地点-时间模式,可以为有针对性的公共卫生行动提供信息。简约 ARIMA 模型的最佳总体样本外性能表明,当无法获得更丰富的环境或昆虫学数据流时,常规 监测 数据可以支持实际的季节性预测。预测应定期更新并与常规流行病学评估一起使用。

papers.title: Epidemiology and spillover risk of SFTSV in animals across East Asia
papers.abstract: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is an emerging tick‐borne zoonosis in East Asia, yet the contribution of animals to virus maintenance and spillover remains incompletely characterized. This review synthesizes current evidence of SFTS virus (SFTSV) infection across domestic livestock, companion animals, wildlife, and captive species, focusing on host range, geographic distribution, diagnostics, and reports of viral RNA and virus isolation. Available data indicate that SFTSV exposure and infection occur across a broad range of animal hosts, supporting a multi-host ecological framework rather than a simple single-reservoir interpretation. Domestic ruminants frequently exhibit high seroprevalence and may function as sentinels of enzootic activity, while occasional virus isolation from cattle demonstrates that viable virus can be recovered from naturally infected livestock, although this does not establish reservoir or amplification competence. Companion animals are considered a potential interface for interspecies transmission, as some studies have documented severe clinical disease, high viral loads, and cat-associated human transmission events supported by varying levels of epidemiological and genomic evidence. Studies in wildlife further document exposure and natural infection across diverse taxa, although their specific roles in viral maintenance remain unresolved. Interpretation of these findings depends heavily on the diagnostic modality: serology primarily indicates prior exposure, RNA detection supports current or recent infection, and virus isolation demonstrates that viable virus was present in the sampled material. Integrating animal infection data within an ecological framework reveals major knowledge gaps related to reservoir competence, infectious shedding, phylogenetic connections among animal, tick, and human cases, and implications for prevention. The review underscores the need for One Health surveillance that incorporates clinical data from companion animals and applies evidence‐based interpretation to improve recognition of animal–human interfaces associated with potential spillover risk.

source_records.abstract: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is an emerging tick‐borne zoonosis in East Asia, yet the contribution of animals to virus maintenance and spillover remains incompletely characterized. This review synthesizes current evidence of SFTS virus (SFTSV) infection across domestic livestock, companion animals, wildlife, and captive species, focusing on host range, geographic distribution, diagnostics, and reports of viral RNA and virus isolation. Available data indicate that SFTSV exposure and infection occur across a broad range of animal hosts, supporting a multi-host ecological framework rather than a simple single-reservoir interpretation. Domestic ruminants frequently exhibit high seroprevalence and may function as sentinels of enzootic activity, while occasional virus isolation from cattle demonstrates that viable virus can be recovered from naturally infected livestock, although this does not establish reservoir or amplification competence. Companion animals are considered a potential interface for interspecies transmission, as some studies have documented severe clinical disease, high viral loads, and cat-associated human transmission events supported by varying levels of epidemiological and genomic evidence. Studies in wildlife further document exposure and natural infection across diverse taxa, although their specific roles in viral maintenance remain unresolved. Interpretation of these findings depends heavily on the diagnostic modality: serology primarily indicates prior exposure, RNA detection supports current or recent infection, and virus isolation demonstrates that viable virus was present in the sampled material. Integrating animal infection data within an ecological framework reveals major knowledge gaps related to reservoir competence, infectious shedding, phylogenetic connections among animal, tick, and human cases, and implications for prevention. The review underscores the need for One Health surveillance that incorporates clinical data from companion animals and applies evidence‐based interpretation to improve recognition of animal-human interfaces associated with potential spillover risk.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the epidemiology and spillover risk of Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus (SFTSV) in animals across East Asia. The study focuses on the host range, geographic distribution, and diagnostic methods for SFTSV infection in domestic livestock, companion animals, wildlife, and captive species. The findings suggest that SFTSV has a broad range of animal hosts, indicating a complex multi-host ecological framework rather than a simple single-reservoir model. While domestic ruminants show high seroprevalence and may act as sentinels for enzootic activity, the role of these animals in viral maintenance and amplification remains unclear. Companion animals are highlighted as potential interfaces for interspecies transmission, with some studies documenting severe clinical disease, high viral loads, and cat-associated human transmission events. The review emphasizes the need for One Health surveillance and evidence-based interpretation to better understand the animal-human interfaces associated with spillover risk. Key gaps include the need for more research on reservoir competence, infectious shedding, and phylogenetic connections among animal, tick, and human cases.

papers.abstract_zh: 发热伴血小板减少综合征(发热伴血小板减少综合征)是一种在东亚地区新兴的蜱媒病毒,然而动物在病毒维持和传播中的作用仍不完全明确。本综述总结了当前关于SFTSV感染在家畜、宠物、野生动物和圈养物种中的证据,重点分析了其宿主范围、地理分布、诊断方法以及病毒RNA检测和病毒分离的报告。现有数据表明,SFTSV的暴露和感染发生在广泛的动物宿主中,支持多宿主生态框架,而非简单的单一宿主解释。家畜(如反刍动物)经常表现出高感染率,可能作为流行病活动的哨兵;偶尔从牛中分离到病毒表明,自然感染的家畜中可以分离出活性病毒,但这一点并不能证明其传播能力或增殖能力。宠物被认为是跨物种传播的潜在接口,因为一些研究记录了严重的临床症状、高病毒载量以及由不同水平的流行病学和基因组证据支持的猫源性人类感染事件。野生动物的研究进一步表明,不同物种中均存在暴露和自然感染,但它们在病毒维持中的具体作用仍未明确。这些发现的解释高度依赖于诊断方法:血清学检测主要表明既往暴露,RNA检测支持当前或近期感染,而病毒分离则表明采样材料中存在活性病毒。将动物感染数据整合到生态框架中,揭示了关于传播能力、传染性排泄、动物、蜱和人类病例之间的系统发育联系以及对预防措施的影响等方面的主要知识空白。综述强调了需要一种结合宠物临床数据的One Health监测策略,并采用基于证据的解释方法,以提高对与潜在传播风险相关的动物-人类接口的认识。

papers.title: Comparative Life History and Demographic Traits of Parthenogenetic and Bisexual Haemaphysalis longicornis in the Republic of Korea.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The Asian longhorned tick, Haemaphysalis longicornis , is one of the predominant hard tick species in the Republic of Korea and an important vector of pathogens affecting both animals and humans, including severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus (SFTSV). longicornis occurs as both parthenogenetic and bisexual reproductive lineages that differ in geographic distribution and several biological characteristics. However, how differences in reproductive output, developmental timing, and stage‐specific survival collectively influence their demographic performance remains poorly understood. In this study, we compared morphology, body weight, blood‐feeding and post‐feeding developmental periods, stage‐specific survival, and reproductive output between parthenogenetic and bisexual lineages. Parthenogenetic females had larger idiosoma dimensions and attained heavier replete body weights than bisexual females. Parthenogenetic nymphs and adults completed blood feeding more rapidly, whereas larval pre‐molting, pre‐oviposition, and egg incubation periods were longer. Survival varied among developmental stages, with bisexual ticks showing higher survival during larval and adult reproductive transitions, including oviposition completion, whereas parthenogenetic ticks showed higher survival during the nymphal stage. Parthenogenetic females were estimated to produce more eggs than bisexual females (3,642 vs. 2,864 eggs per female), but cumulative stage‐transition survival was substantially lower (0.155 vs. Consequently, the estimated daily demographic growth factors were broadly comparable between the parthenogenetic and bisexual lineages ( λ * = 1.0966 and 1.1054, respectively). These findings reveal that the higher reproductive output of parthenogenetic H. longicornis is counterbalanced by lower survival and longer development, highlighting contrasting life‐history trade‐offs rather than a simple demographic advantage of parthenogenesis.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the demographic dynamics of Haemaphysalis longicornis, which is a vector for SFTSV, and may inform surveillance and control strategies for ticks and the pathogens they transmit.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the demographic performance of parthenogenetic and bisexual lineages of Haemaphysalis longicornis in the Republic of Korea, focusing on their life history and biological characteristics. The research highlights that while parthenogenetic females produce more eggs, their survival rates are lower compared to bisexual females. The findings suggest contrasting life-history trade-offs between the two lineages, rather than a clear demographic advantage of parthenogenesis. The study contributes to understanding the biology of H. longicornis, an important vector for severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus (SFTSV), and may inform future research on tick ecology and pathogen transmission. However, the study lacks detailed statistical analysis and does not directly address SFTSV transmission dynamics, limiting the strength of its conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解生殖输出、发育时间和特定阶段存活率的差异如何影响长角血蜱的孤雌生殖和双性谱系的人口表现,长角血蜱是影响动物和人类的病原体的重要 媒介,包括 发热伴血小板减少综合征病毒 (SFTSV)。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项比较研究是在韩国进行的,比较了长角血蜱的形态、体重、摄血和摄食后发育期、特定阶段的存活率以及单性生殖和双性系之间的生殖产出。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用直接观察和测量技术,比较了长角血骺单性生殖和双性系之间的形态、体重、吸血和喂养后发育期、阶段特异性存活率和生殖产出。
elements_zh.main_results: 双性蜱在幼虫和成虫生殖转变期间(包括产卵完成)表现出更高的存活率,而孤雌蜱在若虫阶段表现出更高的存活率。据估计,单性生殖雌性比双性恋雌性产生更多的卵(每雌性 3,642 颗卵对 2,864 颗卵),但累积阶段过渡存活率要低得多(0.155 颗对 2,864 颗)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,单性生殖 H. longicornis 较高的繁殖产量被较低的存活率和较长的发育时间所抵消,突出了对比鲜明的生活史权衡,而不是单性生殖的简单人口统计学优势。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了对长角血蜱(SFTSV 的 媒介)人口动态的深入了解,并可能为 监测 和蜱及其传播的病原体的控制策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其重点关注形态和人口统计学特征,没有直接分析SFTSV 传播或致病性,并且由于缺乏详细的统计分析,证据不充分。

papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT The Asian longhorned tick, Haemaphysalis longicornis , is one of the predominant hard tick species in the Republic of Korea and an important vector of pathogens affecting both animals and humans, including severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus (SFTSV). longicornis occurs as both parthenogenetic and bisexual reproductive lineages that differ in geographic distribution and several biological characteristics. However, how differences in reproductive output, developmental timing, and stage‐specific survival collectively influence their demographic performance remains poorly understood. In this study, we compared morphology, body weight, blood‐feeding and post‐feeding developmental periods, stage‐specific survival, and reproductive output between parthenogenetic and bisexual lineages. Parthenogenetic females had larger idiosoma dimensions and attained heavier replete body weights than bisexual females. Parthenogenetic nymphs and adults completed blood feeding more rapidly, whereas larval pre‐molting, pre‐oviposition, and egg incubation periods were longer. Survival varied among developmental stages, with bisexual ticks showing higher survival during larval and adult reproductive transitions, including oviposition completion, whereas parthenogenetic ticks showed higher survival during the nymphal stage. Parthenogenetic females were estimated to produce more eggs than bisexual females (3,642 vs. 2,864 eggs per female), but cumulative stage‐transition survival was substantially lower (0.155 vs. Consequently, the estimated daily demographic growth factors were broadly comparable between the parthenogenetic and bisexual lineages ( λ * = 1.0966 and 1.1054, respectively). These findings reveal that the higher reproductive output of parthenogenetic H. longicornis is counterbalanced by lower survival and longer development, highlighting contrasting life‐history trade‐offs rather than a simple demographic advantage of parthenogenesis.

papers.title: Spatial and seasonal patterns of tick distribution and climate-driven shifts in Jiangsu Province, an SFTS-affected region of eastern China.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Ticks are important vectors of zoonotic pathogens and play a key role in the transmission of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) in East Asia. However, a comprehensive understanding of their spatial distribution, seasonal activity, and climate-driven habitat suitability remains limited, particularly at the provincial scale. METHODS: This study analyzed long-term surveillance data on free-living ticks in Jiangsu Province, an SFTS-affected region in eastern China, from 2019 ~ 2024. Seasonal dynamics and habitat-associated differences were characterized using descriptive statistics. Environmental determinants of tick distribution and projected climate-driven changes in habitat suitability were assessed using an optimized MaxEnt modeling framework. RESULTS: A total of 8,860 ticks belonging to seven species across three genera were identified, with Haemaphysalis longicornis (89.1%) and Haemaphysalis flava (9.8%) as the dominant species. Tick density varied seasonally, with post-larval ticks predominating during the April peak and larvae predominating during the September peak. Habitat preference differed between dominant species: H. longicornis was most frequently recorded in rural villages (33.7%) and country parks (18.3%), whereas H. flava was predominantly found in urban parks (24.8%) and forest parks (20.0%). Elevation, maximum temperature of the warmest month (bio5), and precipitation of the driest month (bio14) were key environmental determinants. Under current climatic conditions, highly suitable habitats were concentrated in the southwestern hilly areas. Under the SSP245 scenario (SSP, Shared Socioeconomic Pathway), the area classified as highly suitable using scenario-specific Jenks natural breaks was larger in future projections. Compared with the current scenario-specific high-suitability area, this class increased by 336.5% and 640.3% for H. longicornis and by 91.4% and 118.8% for H. flava during 2021 ~ 2040 and 2041 ~ 2060, respectively. CONCLUSION: Tick distribution in eastern China is strongly shaped by climatic constraints and is projected to undergo spatial reorganization, with larger areas falling into the scenario-specific high-suitability class under future climate scenarios. These findings underscore the importance of integrating climate-sensitive vector surveillance into SFTS prevention strategies within a One Health framework.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed long-term surveillance data on free-living ticks in Jiangsu Province from 2019 to 2024, focusing on seasonal dynamics and habitat-associated differences.
analysis.methods: Tick distribution was characterized using descriptive statistics and an optimized MaxEnt modeling framework to assess environmental determinants and project future habitat suitability under different climate scenarios.
analysis.main_results: A total of 8,860 ticks belonging to seven species were identified, with Haemaphysalis longicornis and Haemaphysalis flava as the dominant species. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解中国东部受 发热伴血小板减少综合征 影响的江苏省蜱虫分布的空间和季节模式以及气候驱动的变化,以解决对省级范围内这些因素的全面了解有限的问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了2019年至2024年江苏省自由生活蜱的长期监测数据,重点关注季节动态和栖息地相关差异。
elements_zh.methods: 使用描述性统计数据和优化的 MaxEnt 建模框架来表征蜱分布,以评估环境决定因素并预测不同气候情景下未来栖息地的适宜性。
elements_zh.main_results: 共鉴定蜱虫8860只,分属7个种,其中长角血蜱和黄血蜱为优势种。蜱虫密度随季节变化,四月高峰期以幼虫后蜱为主,九月高峰期以幼虫为主。不同物种对栖息地的偏好有所不同,H. longicornis 更常见于乡村和郊野公园,而 H. flava 更常见于城市和森林公园。主要环境决定因素包括海拔、最热月份的最高气温和最干燥月份的降水量。在目前的气候条件下,高度适宜的生境集中在西南丘陵地区。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了将气候敏感型 媒介 监测 纳入 One Health 框架内的 发热伴血小板减少综合征 预防策略的重要性,并强调需要采取积极措施来应对蜱分布未来潜在的变化。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可以通过确定影响蜱分布和栖息地适宜性的关键区域和环境因素,为 监测 和 发热伴血小板减少综合征 的预防策略提供信息,这对于管理 媒介 传播的疾病至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到对长期 监测 数据的依赖以及使用建模框架来预测未来变化的限制,这可能会带来不确定性。由于该研究的观察性质以及需要通过实地研究进一步验证,证据强度中等。

Tick density varied seasonally, with post-larval ticks predominating during the April peak and larvae during the September peak. Habitat preference differed between species, with H. longicornis found more frequently in rural villages and country parks, and H. flava in urban and forest parks. Key environmental determinants included elevation, maximum temperature of the warmest month, and precipitation of the driest month. Under current climatic conditions, highly suitable habitats were concentrated in the southwestern hilly areas.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the importance of integrating climate-sensitive vector surveillance into SFTS prevention strategies within a One Health framework, emphasizing the need for proactive measures to address potential future changes in tick distribution.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results can inform surveillance and prevention strategies for SFTS by identifying key areas and environmental factors that influence tick distribution and habitat suitability, which are crucial for managing vector-borne diseases.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the reliance on long-term surveillance data and the use of a modeling framework to project future changes, which may introduce uncertainties. The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational nature of the study and the need for further validation through field studies.

papers.title_zh: 中国东部受 发热伴血小板减少综合征 影响的江苏省蜱虫分布的空间和季节模式以及气候驱动的变化。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Ticks are important vectors of zoonotic pathogens and play a key role in the transmission of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) in East Asia. However, a comprehensive understanding of their spatial distribution, seasonal activity, and climate-driven habitat suitability remains limited, particularly at the provincial scale. METHODS: This study analyzed long-term surveillance data on free-living ticks in Jiangsu Province, an SFTS-affected region in eastern China, from 2019 ~ 2024. Seasonal dynamics and habitat-associated differences were characterized using descriptive statistics. Environmental determinants of tick distribution and projected climate-driven changes in habitat suitability were assessed using an optimized MaxEnt modeling framework. RESULTS: A total of 8,860 ticks belonging to seven species across three genera were identified, with Haemaphysalis longicornis (89.1%) and Haemaphysalis flava (9.8%) as the dominant species. Tick density varied seasonally, with post-larval ticks predominating during the April peak and larvae predominating during the September peak. Habitat preference differed between dominant species: H. longicornis was most frequently recorded in rural villages (33.7%) and country parks (18.3%), whereas H. flava was predominantly found in urban parks (24.8%) and forest parks (20.0%). Elevation, maximum temperature of the warmest month (bio5), and precipitation of the driest month (bio14) were key environmental determinants. Under current climatic conditions, highly suitable habitats were concentrated in the southwestern hilly areas. Under the SSP245 scenario (SSP, Shared Socioeconomic Pathway), the area classified as highly suitable using scenario-specific Jenks natural breaks was larger in future projections. Compared with the current scenario-specific high-suitability area, this class increased by 336.5% and 640.3% for H. longicornis and by 91.4% and 118.8% for H. flava during 2021 ~ 2040 and 2041 ~ 2060, respectively. CONCLUSION: Tick distribution in eastern China is strongly shaped by climatic constraints and is projected to undergo spatial reorganization, with larger areas falling into the scenario-specific high-suitability class under future climate scenarios. These findings underscore the importance of integrating climate-sensitive vector surveillance into SFTS prevention strategies within a One Health framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:蜱是重要的人畜共患病原体,在东亚严重发热伴血小板减少综合征(发热伴血小板减少综合征)中发挥关键作用。然而,对其空间分布、季节性活动和气候驱动的栖息地适宜性的全面了解仍然有限,特别是在省级范围内。方法:本研究分析了中国东部 发热伴血小板减少综合征 影响地区江苏省 2019 年至 2024 年自由生活蜱的长期 监测 数据。使用描述性统计来表征季节动态和栖息地相关差异。使用优化的 MaxEnt 建模框架评估了蜱分布的环境决定因素和预测的气候驱动的栖息地适宜性变化。结果共鉴定出3属7个种8 860只蜱,其中长角血蜱(89.1%)和黄血蜱(9.8%)为优势种。蜱密度随季节变化,幼虫后蜱在四月高峰期间占主导地位,幼虫在九月高峰期间占主导地位。优势种之间的栖息地偏好不同:H.​​ longicornis 最常见于乡村(33.7%)和郊野公园(18.3%),而 H. flava 主要发现于城市公园(24.8%)和森林公园(20.0%)。海拔、最热月份的最高气温(bio5)和最干燥月份的降水量(bio14)是关键的环境决定因素。在目前的气候条件下,高度适宜的生境集中在西南丘陵地区。在 SSP245 情景(SSP,共享社会经济路径)下,使用特定情景 Jenks 自然断裂被分类为高度适合的区域在未来的预测中更大。与当前场景特定高适宜区相比,2021~2040年和2041~2060年,长角长角鳅类分别增加了336.5%和640.3%,黄鳅类分别增加了91.4%和118.8%。结论:中国东部的蜱分布受到气候限制的强烈影响,预计将经历空间重组,在未来的气候情景下,更大的区域属于特定情景的高适宜性类别。这些发现强调了将气候敏感型 媒介 监测 纳入 One Health 框架内的 发热伴血小板减少综合征 预防策略的重要性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解中国东部受 发热伴血小板减少综合征 影响的江苏省蜱虫分布的空间和季节模式以及气候驱动的变化,以解决对省级范围内这些因素的全面了解有限的问题。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了2019年至2024年江苏省自由生活蜱的长期监测数据,重点关注季节动态和栖息地相关差异。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用描述性统计数据和优化的 MaxEnt 建模框架来表征蜱分布,以评估环境决定因素并预测不同气候情景下未来栖息地的适宜性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 共鉴定蜱虫8860只,分属7个种,其中长角血蜱和黄血蜱为优势种。蜱虫密度随季节变化,四月高峰期以幼虫后蜱为主,九月高峰期以幼虫为主。不同物种对栖息地的偏好有所不同,H. longicornis 更常见于乡村和郊野公园,而 H. flava 更常见于城市和森林公园。主要环境决定因素包括海拔、最热月份的最高气温和最干燥月份的降水量。在目前的气候条件下,高度适宜的生境集中在西南丘陵地区。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了将气候敏感型 媒介 监测 纳入 One Health 框架内的 发热伴血小板减少综合征 预防策略的重要性,并强调需要采取积极措施来应对蜱分布未来潜在的变化。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可以通过确定影响蜱分布和栖息地适宜性的关键区域和环境因素,为 监测 和 发热伴血小板减少综合征 的预防策略提供信息,这对于管理 媒介 传播的疾病至关重要。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到对长期 监测 数据的依赖以及使用建模框架来预测未来变化的限制,这可能会带来不确定性。由于该研究的观察性质以及需要通过实地研究进一步验证,证据强度中等。

Home Health & Wellness Thailand warns pet owners about potentially deadly tick-borne virus Health & Wellness News Pattaya-Thailand Thailand Thailand warns pet owners about potentially deadly tick-borne virus By Pattaya Mail November 3, 2026 0 965 Share on Facebook Tweet on Twitter Pet owners are advised to check dogs and cats regularly for ticks and take precautions when handling animals. BANGKOK, Thailand – Thailand is raising awareness of Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS), a potentially fatal viral disease spread mainly by infected ticks. Dogs, cats and farm animals can carry infected ticks, putting people who handle or care for them at risk. Symptoms usually appear within one to two weeks and include high fever, fatigue, headache, muscle pain, nausea and diarrhoea. Severe cases can cause bleeding, organ failure and death. There is currently no approved vaccine or specific antiviral treatment, making early medical attention important. Thailand has recorded 10 cases and five deaths since 2019, including three cases and two deaths in the first nine months of 2026, according to the Department of Disease Control. The National Communicable Disease Committee has also approved a draft measure to add SFTS to the country’s disease surveillance system. Health officials advise people to check pets regularly for ticks, use appropriate tick-control products and avoid handling ticks with bare hands. Those working with animals or spending time outdoors should wear protective clothing and check their bodies after exposure. Anyone developing a high fever after a tick bite or close contact with animals should seek medical attention and inform doctors about the exposure. Unlike leptospirosis, which can spread through water contaminated by infected animals, SFTS is primarily a tick-borne infection. The key message is simple: protect pets from ticks and do not ignore a fever after possible exposure. news.content_zh: 泰国已向宠物主人发出关于可能致命的 蜱媒 病毒的警告,该病毒被称为严重发烧伴血小板减少综合症 (发热伴血小板减少综合征)。自 2019 年以来,疾病控制部报告了 10 例病例和 5 例死亡,其中 2026 年前 9 个月发生了 3 例病例和 2 例死亡。卫生官员强调检查宠物是否有蜱虫、使用蜱虫控制产品以及避免直接接触蜱虫的重要性。他们还建议从事动物工作或在户外活动的个人穿上防护服并监测身体是否有蜱虫。发热伴血小板减少综合征 的症状包括高烧、疲劳、头痛、肌肉疼痛、恶心和腹泻,通常在接触后一到两周内出现。严重病例可导致出血、器官衰竭和死亡,目前尚无批准的 疫苗 或特定的 抗病毒药物 治疗 可用。国家传染病委员会已批准一项措施草案,将 发热伴血小板减少综合征 纳入国家疾病 监测 系统,突显人们对这种病毒日益增长的担忧。敦促宠物主人采取预防措施,防止蜱虫叮咬,如果他们或他们的宠物在可能接触后出现高烧,请立即就医。

news.content: container The Asia Business Daily Open Navigation Stock Economy Real estate Industry · IT Politics Society World Culture·Life Opinion·Editorial Visual-News Nationwide Suspect Tick-Borne Infection if Fever or Chills Follow a Fall Foliage Outing Language Language Close KR CN Open Search bar Search field News Search Remove icon Search icon Dim Nationwide Honam Suspect Tick-Borne Infection if Fever or Chills Follow a Fall Foliage Outing by Sim Jinseok Published 03 Nov.2026 16:28(KST) Share Language Text Size Print Gwangju Special City to Strengthen Cooperation Between Medical Institutions and Public Health Centers Jeonnam-Gwangju Integrated Special City is concentrating its administrative efforts on preventing tick-borne infectious diseases, which peak in the fall. According to Gwangju Special City, 72.1% of cases of major tick-borne infectious diseases in South Korea over the past three years occurred from September to November. Tick larvae that transmit scrub typhus are particularly active in November, so caution is advised when hiking or camping. Gwangju Special City is stepping up administrative measures to prevent the spread of these infectious diseases. Promotional Material on the Prevention and Management of Tick-Borne Infectious Diseases. View original image The city will focus its guidance on areas with heavy outdoor activity, including trailheads, major tourist attractions, campgrounds, and recreational forests. In rural areas, it plans to distribute informational materials at senior centers and village halls and actively inform residents about prevention guidelines. Medical institutions and public health centers will work together to promptly determine whether patients with unexplained fevers in the fall have tick-borne infections. Scrub typhus generally causes fever, headaches, chills, and rashes within 10 days of infection. A characteristic symptom is a black scab, called an eschar, at the site of a chigger bite. Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), which is transmitted by hard ticks, causes symptoms such as fever, vomiting, and diarrhea. Home Health & Wellness Thailand warns pet owners about potentially deadly tick-borne virus Health & Wellness News Pattaya-Thailand Thailand Thailand warns pet owners about potentially deadly tick-borne virus By Pattaya Mail November 3, 2026 0 963 Share on Facebook Tweet on Twitter tweet Pet owners are advised to check dogs and cats regularly for ticks and take precautions when handling animals. BANGKOK, Thailand – Thailand is raising awareness of Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS), a potentially fatal viral disease spread mainly by infected ticks. Dogs, cats and farm animals can carry infected ticks, putting people who handle or care for them at risk. Symptoms usually appear within one to two weeks and include high fever, fatigue, headache, muscle pain, nausea and diarrhoea. Severe cases can cause bleeding, organ failure and death. There is currently no approved vaccine or specific antiviral treatment, making early medical attention important. Thailand has recorded 10 cases and five deaths since 2019, including three cases and two deaths in the first nine months of 2026, according to the Department of Disease Control. The National Communicable Disease Committee has also approved a draft measure to add SFTS to the country’s disease surveillance system. Health officials advise people to check pets regularly for ticks, use appropriate tick-control products and avoid handling ticks with bare hands. Those working with animals or spending time outdoors should wear protective clothing and check their bodies after exposure. Anyone developing a high fever after a tick bite or close contact with animals should seek medical attention and inform doctors about the exposure. Unlike leptospirosis, which can spread through water contaminated by infected animals, SFTS is primarily a tick-borne infection. The key message is simple: protect pets from ticks and do not ignore a fever after possible exposure.
